scope: Laboratory validation of the combined co2gap initial-mass assumption; no change to the frozen release or public site.
question: How does the co2gap modelled initial mass distribution compare with airline-derived take-off weights after conditioning on aircraft type and distance?

external_source.title: Dataset for EUROCONTROL PRC 2024 Data Challenge on Aircraft Take-off Weight Estimation
external_source.population_note: 527,162 flights, reported as 6.1% of EUROCONTROL traffic; airline participation and complete weight data determine inclusion.
external_source.label_caveat: The repository describes airline-provided actual take-off weights but its README names the public tow field estimated take-off weight. Treat the label as airline-derived reference data, not measurement-error-free ground truth.

co2gap_target.selection: Exact release days; both endpoints resolved, coverage at least 0.85, flown/great-circle gate passed and great-circle distance at least 150 km.

nominal_assumptions.trip_fuel: OpenAP iterative closure on the observed trajectory

aircraft_reference.normalisation: initial_mass_kg / MTOW for co2gap and tow / MTOW for PRC
aircraft_reference.variant_caveat: An ICAO type designator does not resolve an exact airframe, cabin or engine variant.

shared: Aircraft type maps through the co2gap OpenAP alias table and has finite positive OEW and MTOW.
Distance is finite and at least 150 km.
Mass is finite and lies from OEW through MTOW, inclusive.
prc: Date parses as UTC and belongs to 2022.
flown_distance is converted from nautical miles to kilometres with factor 1.852.
Duplicate flight_id rows are an error, not silently deduplicated.
co2gap: Day belongs to the immutable release manifest.
coverage_frac, flown_ge_09gc, endpoint and great-circle gates reproduce the release flight-quality gate.
Duplicate day plus flight_id rows are an error.

standardisation.weights: Each retained cell receives its share of eligible co2gap release rows. PRC rows within a cell receive equal weight.
standardisation.guard: If common retained cells cover less than 80% of eligible release rows, the analysis is incomplete and exits non-zero.

estimands.primary: 100 times the release-weighted mean of (co2gap mean initial_mass/MTOW minus PRC mean tow/MTOW) within common cells, in percentage points of MTOW.
secondary: Release-standardised weighted median and interquartile range in each source.
Release-weighted mean absolute and root-mean-square cell differences.
Differences by aircraft type and distance band, reported only for retained cells.
Raw source composition and the fraction of each source retained by every eligibility step.
estimands.sign: Positive means the co2gap initial mass is heavier than the PRC reference after standardisation.

precision.method: Resample PRC UTC dates as whole blocks with replacement; keep the co2gap release population and its cell weights fixed.
precision.interpretation: A descriptive day-block sampling-precision interval conditional on the selected PRC dataset and fixed design, not a physical or total uncertainty interval.

robustness: Repeat the primary calculation with minimum cell counts 30 and 300.
Repeat after allowing the PRC reference mass up to 1.02 times OpenAP MTOW, while continuing to report those rows as property/label mismatches.
Report unstandardised source summaries to expose the effect of post-stratification.
Report results by broad aircraft type and distance groups; do not pool a cell that fails its declared minimum.
decision_use: Use the sign, scale and cell pattern to redesign combined initial-mass sensitivity scenarios.
Do not infer separate load-factor, reserve-fuel or trip-fuel distributions from TOW alone.
Do not mark load_factor or reserve_fuel quantified solely from this comparison.
Do not change a release headline, publish an uncertainty interval or recalibrate the production model without a separate propagation design and review.
known_noncomparabilities: PRC represents 2022 and co2gap represents January to July 2026.
PRC airline participation is selective and airline identities are obfuscated.
PRC and co2gap distance fields come from different trajectory-processing chains.
Aircraft type codes do not identify cabin, airframe or engine variants.
The comparison validates combined take-off mass, not the individual assumptions that compose it.
